MA
Maria Aqdas · Virtual University of Pakistan

I'm a 5th-semester BS Data Science student at the Virtual University of Pakistan. I enjoy exploring data, finding patterns, solving problems, and building things with code.

My main skills include Python, SQL, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Data Visualization, and Machine Learning. I enjoy working with real-world datasets and using these skills to develop practical projects.

I've worked on projects involving machine learning, data analysis, and AI-powered applications. One of my proudest achievements was securing 1st place among 311 projects at the Pak Angels & HEC Generative AI Hackathon with my team project, Legal Lens AI.

I'm also a Kaggle Datasets Expert, with 6 published datasets and 55+ public notebooks.

I'm continuously learning, improving my technical skills, and exploring new ways to use data to solve real-world problems.
